class_names: Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf

Apple Scab Leaf.disease: Apple Scab (सेब का स्कैब / पपड़ी रोग)
Apple Scab Leaf.symptoms: Olive-green to velvety brown spots on leaves, becoming corky and causing premature leaf drop. (पत्तियों पर जैतूनी हरे धब्बे जो बाद में भूरे और पपड़ीदार हो जाते हैं)
Apple Scab Leaf.chemical_treatment: Spray Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L at green tip and petal fall stages.
Apple Scab Leaf.organic_treatment: Neem oil spray (5ml/L), dormant copper spray (3g/L) before bud break, remove fallen leaves.
Apple Scab Leaf.prevention: Prune tree canopies to improve air circulation and sunlight penetration; rake and burn infected fallen leaves.

Apple leaf.symptoms: Lush green, glossy leaf surface without any lesions or discoloration.
Apple leaf.organic_treatment: Regular foliar seaweed extract or compost tea spray for immunity.
Apple leaf.prevention: Maintain balanced N-P-K nutrition and adequate orchard drainage.

Apple rust leaf.disease: Cedar Apple Rust (सेब का गेरुई / रतुआ रोग)
Apple rust leaf.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange circular spots on upper leaf surface, producing rust-like fungal tubes beneath. (पत्तियों पर चमकीले नारंगी-पीले धब्बे)
Apple rust leaf.chemical_treatment: Spray Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 1g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5g/L at pink bud stage.
Apple rust leaf.organic_treatment: Sulfur-based organic fungicide dust (2g/L) or Copper soap spray.
Apple rust leaf.prevention: Remove nearby wild juniper/cedar host trees within 500 meters of the orchard.

Bell_pepper leaf.symptoms: Uniform deep green foliage, crisp leaf margin with healthy venation.
Bell_pepper leaf.organic_treatment: Neem cake soil application (50g/plant) as preventative repellent.
Bell_pepper leaf.prevention: Ensure good soil aeration and avoid over-irrigation.

Bell_pepper leaf spot.disease: Bacterial Leaf Spot (जीवाणु पत्ती धब्बा रोग)
Bell_pepper leaf spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked, dark brown angular spots with yellow halos. (पत्तियों पर पानी जैसे धब्बे जो बाद में भूरे हो जाते हैं)
Bell_pepper leaf spot.organic_treatment: Pseudomonas fluorescens foliar spray @ 5g/L; avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.
Bell_pepper leaf spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds; practice 2-year crop rotation without Solanaceous crops.

Blueberry leaf.symptoms: Healthy dark green, smooth leaves with intact cuticle layer.
Blueberry leaf.organic_treatment: Pine needle mulch to maintain acidic soil pH (4.5 - 5.2).
Blueberry leaf.prevention: Maintain acidic soil conditions and steady drip moisture.

Cherry leaf.symptoms: Vibrant green leaves, uniform shape, free of shot-hole spots or curling.
Cherry leaf.organic_treatment: Organic kelp extract spray during flower set.
Cherry leaf.prevention: Ensure canopy aeration and adequate drainage in temperate slopes.

Corn Gray leaf spot.disease: Gray Leaf Spot (ग्रे लीफ स्पॉट / धूसर पत्ती धब्बा)
Corn Gray leaf spot.symptoms: Rectangular, brown to gray lesions running parallel between leaf veins. (नसों के बीच आयताकार धूसर धब्बे)
Corn Gray leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1ml/L or Carbendazim @ 1g/L.
Corn Gray leaf spot.organic_treatment: Trichoderma harzianum soil and foliar spray @ 5g/L.
Corn Gray leaf spot.prevention: Crop rotation with legumes; plow under crop residue after harvest to destroy fungal spores.

Corn leaf blight.disease: Northern Corn Leaf Blight (मक्का झुलसा रोग)
Corn leaf blight.symptoms: Long, cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions on lower leaves progressing upwards. (सिगार के आकार के बड़े धब्बे)
Corn leaf blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L at disease onset.
Corn leaf blight.organic_treatment: Neem kernel aqueous extract (5%) spray at 10-day intervals.
Corn leaf blight.prevention: Plant resistant hybrid seeds (e.g. Ganga-5, Vivek Hybrid); avoid high plant density.

Corn rust leaf.disease: Common Corn Rust (मक्का का रतुआ रोग)
Corn rust leaf.symptoms: Cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered on both upper and lower leaf surfaces. (पत्तियों पर कत्थई रंग के उभरे हुए दाने/फुंसियां)
Corn rust leaf.organic_treatment: Sulfur 80% WDG @ 2g/L; spray in cool morning hours.
Corn rust leaf.prevention: Plant early in the season to escape mid-monsoon peak fungal humidity.

Peach leaf.symptoms: Clean, lance-shaped bright green leaves with serrated margins.
Peach leaf.organic_treatment: Dormant Bordeaux mixture spray (1%) in winter for preventative care.
Peach leaf.prevention: Monitor for aphid infestation in early spring.

Potato leaf.symptoms: Compound green foliage, no curling, yellowing, or necrotic margins.
Potato leaf.organic_treatment: Foliar vermiwash spray (10%) for vigor and vitality.
Potato leaf.prevention: Use certified seed tubers (Kufri Jyoti/Giriraj) and earth up ridges properly.

Potato leaf early blight.disease: Potato Early Blight (आलू का अगेती झुलसा)
Potato leaf early blight.symptoms: Target-board circular dark brown spots with concentric rings on older leaves. (पत्तियों पर छल्लेदार गोल कत्थई धब्बे - Target board effect)
Potato leaf early blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L at 7-10 day intervals.
Potato leaf early blight.organic_treatment: Trichoderma viride foliar spray @ 5g/L; copper hydroxide @ 2g/L.
Potato leaf early blight.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer; maintain optimal potassium and drip irrigate in morning.

Potato leaf late blight.disease: Potato Late Blight (आलू का पछेती झुलसा - Phytophthora)
Potato leaf late blight.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions rapidly turning black with white cottony fungal mold on leaf underside under cool humid weather. (पत्तियों पर तेजी से काले होते धब्बे और नीचे सफेद फफूंद)
Potato leaf late blight.chemical_treatment: Immediate spray of Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Curzate) @ 3g/L or Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5g/L.
Potato leaf late blight.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3g/L before rain; destroy blighted haulms.
Potato leaf late blight.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars (Kufri Girdhari, Kufri Himalini); spray prophylactic mancozeb before foggy cold wave.

Raspberry leaf.symptoms: Healthy serrated composite leaves with pale silver underside.
Raspberry leaf.organic_treatment: Compost mulch and organic bio-fertilizer application.
Raspberry leaf.prevention: Maintain trellising to keep canes upright and well aerated.

Soyabean leaf.symptoms: Trifoliate lush green leaves with clean veins.
Soyabean leaf.prevention: Ensure good drainage to avoid collar rot.

Soybean leaf.symptoms: Healthy deep green trifoliate foliage without yellow mosaic.
Soybean leaf.organic_treatment: Neem oil spray (3ml/L) as insect deterrent.

Squash Powdery mildew leaf.symptoms: White talcum-powder-like fungal patches on leaf surface, causing yellowing and premature drying. (पत्तियों पर सफेद पाउडर जैसे धब्बे)
Squash Powdery mildew leaf.chemical_treatment: Spray Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1ml/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/L or Wettable Sulfur 80% @ 2g/L.
Squash Powdery mildew leaf.organic_treatment: Milk-water spray (1:9 ratio) or potassium bicarbonate (3g/L) + Neem oil (5ml/L).
Squash Powdery mildew leaf.prevention: Water at the soil base only; space vines generously to allow air movement.

Strawberry leaf.symptoms: Healthy three-leaflet deep green foliage with bright saw-toothed margins.
Strawberry leaf.organic_treatment: Straw mulching to keep leaves off damp soil.
Strawberry leaf.prevention: Use drip tape beneath black plastic mulch.

Tomato Early blight leaf.disease: Tomato Early Blight (टमाटर का अगेती झुलसा - Alternaria)
Tomato Early blight leaf.symptoms: Brown to black spots with concentric rings surrounded by yellow chlorotic margins on lower leaves. (निचली पत्तियों पर गोल छल्लेदार काले-भूरे धब्बे)
Tomato Early blight leaf.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L at 7-10 day intervals.
Tomato Early blight leaf.organic_treatment: Neem seed kernel extract (5%) or Copper Hydroxide @ 2g/L; prune lower 12 inches of infected foliage.
Tomato Early blight leaf.prevention: Stake plants upright; mulch soil surface to prevent soil splash during rain.

Tomato Septoria leaf spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular spots (1-3mm) with gray/tan centers and dark brown borders with tiny black dots inside. (छोटे गोल धब्बे जिनके बीच का हिस्सा हल्का भूरा होता है)
Tomato Septoria leaf spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3g/L.
Tomato Septoria leaf spot.prevention: Disinfect garden tools; avoid touching plants when foliage is wet.

Tomato leaf.symptoms: Vibrant emerald green, pinnate leaves with healthy trichomes (hairs) and fragrant aroma.
Tomato leaf.prevention: Maintain proper staking, trellising, and uniform moisture.

Tomato leaf bacterial spot.disease: Bacterial Spot (टमाटर का जीवाणु धब्बा रोग)
Tomato leaf bacterial spot.symptoms: Small, dark, greasy water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown-black and cause ragged holes. (छोटे चिकने काले धब्बे)
Tomato leaf bacterial spot.chemical_treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.5g/10L water.
Tomato leaf bacterial spot.organic_treatment: Spray certified copper soap formulation; remove severely infected branches immediately.
Tomato leaf bacterial spot.prevention: Hot water seed treatment (50°C for 25 min); 3-year crop rotation away from solanaceous plants.

Tomato leaf late blight.disease: Tomato Late Blight (टमाटर का पछेती झुलसा - Phytophthora)
Tomato leaf late blight.symptoms: Large, dark water-soaked greasy lesions turning papery brown, with white downy fungal fuzz under high humidity. (पत्तियों पर तेजी से फैलते काले-कत्थई गीले धब्बे)
Tomato leaf late blight.chemical_treatment: Emergency spray of Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1g/L + Mancozeb @ 2g/L OR Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5g/L.
Tomato leaf late blight.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) or Copper Hydroxide spray; destroy infected plants promptly.
Tomato leaf late blight.prevention: Select tolerant varieties (e.g. Pant Bahar, Kashi Amrit); avoid overhead irrigation and dense planting.

Tomato leaf mosaic virus.disease: Tomato Mosaic Virus - ToMV (टमाटर मोज़ेक वायरस)
Tomato leaf mosaic virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic pattern on leaves, fern-like leaf distortion and stunting. (पत्तियों पर हल्के और गहरे हरे रंग के चितकबरे धब्बे और मुड़ाव)
Tomato leaf mosaic virus.chemical_treatment: No chemical cure for viral infections. Control insect vectors (aphids/thrips) with Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/L.
Tomato leaf mosaic virus.organic_treatment: Spray skimmed milk solution (10%) to neutralize mechanical virus transmission; rogue out infected plants.
Tomato leaf mosaic virus.prevention: Wash hands with soap before touching plants; smokers must avoid handling seedlings.

Tomato leaf yellow virus.disease: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus - TYLCV (टमाटर पत्ती मरोड़ रोग)
Tomato leaf yellow virus.symptoms: Severe upward leaf curling, yellowing of leaf margins, stunted bushy plant growth with no fruit set. (पत्तियों का ऊपर की ओर मुड़ना, किनारों का पीला पड़ना)
Tomato leaf yellow virus.chemical_treatment: Control Whitefly vector: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.5g/L.
Tomato leaf yellow virus.organic_treatment: Install yellow sticky traps (15 traps/acre); spray 5% Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) weekly.
Tomato leaf yellow virus.prevention: Cover seedling nursery with 40-mesh insect-proof nylon net.

Tomato mold leaf.disease: Leaf Mold (पत्ती फफूंद / लीफ मोल्ड - Passalora)
Tomato mold leaf.symptoms: Pale green or yellow spots on upper leaf surface, with dense olive-green to brown velvety mold on leaf underside. (पत्ती के निचले हिस्से पर मखमली जैतूनी फफूंद)
Tomato mold leaf.organic_treatment: Spray baking soda solution (5g/L) + Neem oil (3ml/L); ventilate polyhouse greenhouse thoroughly.
Tomato mold leaf.prevention: Lower greenhouse relative humidity below 85%; space plants widely.

Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf.disease: Two-Spotted Spider Mite Damage (लाल मकड़ी / माइट्स का प्रकोप)
Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf.symptoms: Fine yellow stippling/flecking on upper leaf surface, fine silken webbing on leaf undersides, leaves turning bronze. (पत्तियों पर बारीक पीले बिंदु और जाले)
Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf.chemical_treatment: Spray Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L or Propargite 57% EC @ 2ml/L.
Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf.organic_treatment: Spray water jet to dislodge mites; apply Wettable Sulfur @ 2g/L or Neem oil (5ml/L).
Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf.prevention: Avoid drought stress and dusty conditions; introduce predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).

grape leaf.symptoms: Broad, palmately lobed green leaves with healthy veins and smooth texture.
grape leaf.organic_treatment: Balanced micronutrient zinc and boron spray before flowering.
grape leaf.prevention: Proper canopy shoot thinning and trellis management.

grape leaf black rot.disease: Grape Black Rot (अंगूर का काला सड़न रोग - Guignardia)
grape leaf black rot.symptoms: Small, reddish-brown circular spots on leaves with dark borders and tiny black fruiting pycnidia inside. (पत्तियों पर लाल-भूरे गोल धब्बे)
grape leaf black rot.chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Tebuconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L starting at early shoot development.
grape leaf black rot.organic_treatment: Copper soap spray (3g/L); remove and destroy mummified berries and infected canes.
grape leaf black rot.prevention: Prune grapevines to maximize solar exposure and air movement; bury infected vine refuse.
